newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Malaysian prime minister holds talks in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian prime minister holds talks in Bahrain.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad and Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa on Monday discussed ways to boost ties between their Moslem states, the Gulf News Agency reported.
Sheikh Isa told Mahathir his three-day visit to the Gulf Arab state would increase cooperation in trade, tourism and investments, it said.
Mahathir arrived in Manama from Kuwait on Monday. He will be a main speaker at a two-day Gulf economic forum due to open in Bahrain on Tuesday.
